stories.title: Define Clinical Trials Search Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define request/response schema for clinical trials search including condition, recruiting status, title, phase, summary, eligibility, locations, and optional travel distance/time. Align with Pydantic models and service output.

stories.title: Implement Clinical Trials Search Core Logic
stories.description: Implement search logic using ClinicalTrials.gov API with recruiting filter, parse results into normalized structure, extract trial metadata (title, phase, summary, eligibility, locations).

stories.title: Add Travel Distance and Duration Enrichment
stories.description: Integrate Google Routes API to compute optional travel distance and duration from user location to trial sites and append to trial results.

stories.title: Expose Clinical Trials Search via Evaluate Care Facade and Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate clinical trials search into evaluate_care_facade and register with tool_router for validated invocation, ensuring structured response delivery to the chat agent.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Create tests for schema validation, API fetch, parsing logic, travel enrichment, and end-to-end facade invocation including edge cases such as no results and partial data.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials test file found; must create new tests under backend/tests/ for clinical_trials_service and facade integration.
